review_type: Independent internal static review; not a GitHub approval
result: SUPERSEDED: bare preseeded mismatch required a narrower authorization rule
resolved_findings: Curated display names cannot be upstream identity authority.
A posting without snapshots must block bootstrap even when other valid history exists.
Both immutable origin and current source URL must identify unexplained legacy postings.
Validate exact snapshot identity as well as its raw checksum.
reviewed_contracts: Provider-wide deterministic receipt under existing company ingestion lock.
Full Unicode-preserving label digest separate from curated company fields.
Receipt insertion rolls back with downstream collection failures.
Legacy candidate, snapshot, posting, source and provider bindings are checked.
64 distinct historical snapshots plus an overflow sentinel; no arbitrary legacy winner.
Fixed conflict/review error codes; no raw label in receipt or failure diagnostics.
Guard limited to WWR, RemoteOK and Remotive; no ATS authorization change.
limitations: Legacy identities with more than 64 distinct snapshots require review even if legitimate.
The cap bounds recovered payloads, not all database query work; ordinary receipt-backed polls use primary-key lookup.
Append-only integrity is an application convention, not new database-level tamper resistance.
No broader MJ-REQ-017 acceptance or production rollout is established by this review.
